# OpenVR SDK 2.15.6

This directory contains the minimal Win32 subset of Valve's OpenVR SDK required to build and package Penumbra VR:

- C/C++ public headers
- Win32 import library
- Win32 runtime loader
- Valve's OpenVR license

Source: <https://github.com/ValveSoftware/openvr/releases/tag/v2.15.6>

The source archive was downloaded from the official GitHub tag. SHA-256 checksums used during vendoring:
